notes.title: Hash Oasis: The launch of a new social interactive game on Steam!
notes.notes:
Dear Gamers,

We are excited to announce that Hash Oasis, our latest title, will be available for free to the public on April 11, 2024 at 11:30! The game aims to redefine the way players connect with each other through innovative social interaction experiences.
Hash Oasis is a game that combines game social, anchor interaction and opposite-sex social elements, allowing players to enjoy the fun of the game while also building real human relationships in the vast virtual world. Whether you're looking for a gaming partner, want to interact with a favorite streamer, or desire a deeper connection with players of the opposite sex, this game has you met. Our team is committed to creating a diverse gaming environment where players can interact and communicate like never before, whether through carefully designed social missions or live interactive live streaming features. We invite game lovers from all over the world to join Hash Oasis and experience this unique social interaction adventure together.
Hash Oasis will bring you an unprecedented gaming experience. We believe that through games, the world will become more connected.
Thank you for your support and let's meet in Hash Oasis!

Courtesy of the Hash Oasis team
